row.evidence: Sterling (now a First Advantage company) publishes no prices or plans, only a contact form for prospects, and neither its site nor its API reference mentions SSO or SCIM for the client portal.
row.notes: New row. Assumed to be Sterling background screening (sterlingcheck.com), now part of First Advantage. Quote-only, no public plans. No SCIM or SSO documentation was found on sterlingcheck.com (966 sitemap URLs), fadv.com (974 sitemap URLs plus llms.txt) or the Sterling API Postman reference; the client portal's admin help centre is not public, so status is unknown rather than none. The public REST API (OAuth client credentials) manages candidates and screenings, not portal users. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SSO or user-provisioning documentation found on sterlingcheck.com, fadv.com or the Sterling API reference. The client portal's admin help is not public.

auth.notes: OAuth client credentials (Client ID and Client Secret) via POST /oauth.

user_api.notes: False by absence for portal users: the Sterling API covers packages, candidates, screenings, documents, adverse actions, reports, monitoring and a read-only sub-accounts list; it has no endpoints for client-portal users or roles. Base URL shown is the integration (test) host from the Postman collection.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (sterling-tutorial, sterling-talent-solutions-tutorial return 404).

fallbacks.notes: The screening API reference is public; client-portal admin documentation is not.
